name: 🎬 AI Video Editor — Revision Loop Edition

parameters.formDescription: Upload clips to a Google Drive folder (named: clip_1.mp4, clip_2.mp4...). Optionally add music. Write plain-English editing instructions.

values.placeholder: Add title 'AI is Changing Everything' at top 0:00-0:04. Caption 'Subscribe!' center at 0:10-0:14. Speed up clip 2 by 1.5x. Wipe transition between clip 1 and 2.

parameters.formDescription: Describe what to change in the video. Be specific: clip positions, timing, text content, replace a clip, speed changes, etc.

values.placeholder:
Examples:
- Replace clip 2 with clip 4
- Move the title to center and change text to 'Watch This!'
- Remove the caption at 0:10
- Make the transition between clip 1 and 2 a zoom-in instead of fade
- Make clip 3 slow-motion at 0.5x speed

parameters.command:
=#!/bin/sh
set -e
echo "=== 🎬 AI Video Editor — Render v{{ $json.iteration }} ==="
echo "Clips in order: {{ $json.clipOrder.join(', ') }}"
echo "Effective clips: {{ $json.effectiveCount }}"
echo "Ops applied: {{ $json.editOpsApplied }}"

MUSIC_ID="{{ $json.musicId }}"
CLIP_ORDER="{{ $json.clipOrder.join(' ') }}"
EFFECTIVE_COUNT={{ $json.effectiveCount }}

# Build input flags in clip order
INPUTS=""
for i in $CLIP_ORDER; do
  INPUTS="$INPUTS -i /tmp/clip_$i.mp4"
done

# Add music if provided
if [ -n "$MUSIC_ID" ]; then
  INPUTS="$INPUTS -i /tmp/music.mp3"
fi

rm -f /tmp/output.mp4

FILTER='{{ $json.filterComplex }}'

eval "ffmpeg -y $INPUTS \
  -filter_complex \"$FILTER\" \
  -map '[finalv]' \
  -map '[finala]' \
  -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 22 \
  -c:a aac -b:a 128k \
  -movflags +faststart \
  -shortest /tmp/output_v{{ $json.iteration }}.mp4"

echo "✅ Render v{{ $json.iteration }} complete!"
ls -lh /tmp/output_v{{ $json.iteration }}.mp4

parameters.name: ={{ 'preview_' + $('⚙️ Build FFmpeg Filter Graph').item.json.run_id + '_v' + $('⚙️ Build FFmpeg Filter Graph').item.json.iteration + '.mp4' }}
